name: autobuild
description: AI-assisted software building, eight skills. Autobuild finds where a build stands and hands off to the right skill, to start or resume it. Explore turns an idea into a PRD and roadmap. Spec writes each phase's contract. Implement builds it test-first. Wrap checks it, ships it, and reports back. Replan archives a build and hands back a clean slate to pivot from. Migrate brings old build-stack projects onto this stack, once. Polish drains the backlog in small batches. Invoked as /autobuild, or /autobuild:<name> for one directly.
